stories.event: Trump announces renewed military strikes on Iran — 'WILL BE ATTACKING IRAN HARD' / 'Today we will strike Iran hard again'
stories.timeline: Breaking 15:48-15:55 UTC. US strikes already completed overnight (20 targets). Trump now threatening second wave targeting power plants and bridges. Israel also preparing strikes on Iran.
stories.consensus_narrative: Escalation-de-escalation whiplash. Iran shot down US Apache over Hormuz → US retaliatory strikes overnight → Iran struck Bahrain/Jordan → Trump now threatens 'hard' attacks on infrastructure. But simultaneously says 'they just need to sign the paper' and deal is 'fully negotiated'. Market reading: volatility spike, but traders expect de-escalation before US close.
stories.contradiction: Trump flipped from 'strikes completed' (00:57 UTC) to 'will attack hard again' (15:48 UTC) within 15 hours. Parallel messaging: (a) 'deal is done / just needs signing' vs (b) 'going to hit them again today'. Iran's military 'doesn't exist anymore' per Trump, yet Iran struck Bahrain/Jordan successfully. Biggest contradiction: the deal that Trump says is 'fully negotiated' is somehow simultaneous with renewed bombing.
stories.bet: SHORT oil/energy into the threat spike, target fade within 2 hours. Every prior Iran escalation under Trump has faded within the same session once 'deal is close' narrative re-emerges. If WTI spikes above $78 on headline, short. If Trump goes live on Fox with more threats, wait 15 min for peak, then position for fade. The 'Praise Be To Allah' signal from Trump (infinityhedge/26681) confirms he's oscillating back toward resolution. Also: short volatility (UVXY) into US close — VIX spike is a sell.
stories.benefit: Oil spike fade: WTI likely to settle back to $74-76 range within 2 hours as deal narrative reasserts. Iran deal completion would drop oil $5-8/bbl. If Trump instead follows through with infrastructure strikes (bridges/power plants) — genuine escalation, not bluff — then long oil, short equities, long defense (RTX, LMT). Watch for: Trump signing Secure America Act (15:20 UTC) could be the venue for announcement.

stories.event: US May CPI in-line headline but core M/M below expectations (+0.2% vs +0.3% est) — inflation at 3-year high, bond traders price Fed hike by end-2026
stories.timeline: Released ~12:30 UTC June 10. Data now fully digested.
stories.consensus_narrative: Headline CPI +4.2% Y/Y at 3-year high confirms inflation is sticky. Core M/M softer than expected (+0.2% vs +0.3%) gives Fed cover to hold — but bond market still pricing a hike by Dec 2026. Beef prices at all-time highs in US retail are the visceral inflation signal.
stories.contradiction: Core CPI softening vs headline sticky. Bond market prices hike (hawkish) but weaker core suggests no urgency. Putin claims Russia inflation is under control and key rate can be cut — opposite macro regime. The 'soft core' print gives risk assets a bid while bond vigilantes keep long-end yields elevated.
stories.bet: LONG Nasdaq / QQQ on the core miss. If bonds don't sell off further and core trend is softening, tech can rally on 'peak hawkishness' thesis. The S&P and Nasdaq were down 1.2% and 2% yesterday (June 9) — today's CPI gives dip-buyers a catalyst. BlackRock explicitly called tech selloff 'opportunity to generate alpha'.
stories.benefit: QQQ recovery toward prior resistance levels. NVDA remains the macro proxy — AI trade intact (Anthropic Claude Fable 5 released, SpaceX IPO Friday, OpenAI files S-1). Tech positioning: long NVDA, ANTH (if public), MSTR (MicroStrategy bought 1,550 BTC last week). Hard asset inflation (beef prices) suggests consumer staples can also run.

stories.event: SpaceX IPO on Nasdaq (SPCX) scheduled June 12 — $250B+ demand against $75B raise target — biggest IPO in history
stories.timeline: Filing confirmed. IPO date June 12 (Friday this week). 1Q rev $4.69B, net loss $4.28B. $18.7B FY2025 revenue. Starlink 10.3M subscribers.
stories.consensus_narrative: SpaceX IPO is the marquee event of 2026. $1.8T+ expected valuation. $250B in demand vs $75B raise — massively oversubscribed. Elon Musk has 85.1% voting power. Symbol SPCX on Nasdaq. This is compressing AI/space/crypto narratives into one instrument.
stories.contradiction: Valuation at $1.8T on $18.7B revenue (~96x sales) vs operating loss of $2.6B. Retail demand is euphoric, institutional allocation will dominate. The net loss in Q1 ($4.28B) against revenue growth trajectory creates a wedge — this is a narrative-driven, not fundamentals-driven, IPO. Also: Trump mentioned 'public will become very rich from AI action' — could be a catalyst for the broader AI/tech complex pre-IPO.
stories.bet: LONG SPCX-related proxies: if you can't get IPO allocation, positions in satellite/space-adjacent stocks (ASTS, IRDM) and crypto (Starlink/connectivity angle). The Musk/Trump alignment adds a political premium. Watch for: Trump mentioning SpaceX/SPCX in his Iran press availability — would be a massive brand awareness pump.
stories.benefit: Pre-IPO positioning: long ASTS, long BTC (MicroStrategy bought 1,550 BTC last week, Saylor positioning for crypto-financed SpaceX play). The $250B demand signal makes this the liquidity event of the year — expect correlated asset pumps into Friday.
